spec_features.feature_name: hard caps: turns / wall-clock / token budget
spec_features.evidence: Turns ENFORCED: agent_loop.py:75 `for i in range(max_turns)` with else->hit_turn_cap. Wall-clock ENFORCED: agent_loop.py:76-77 `if time.time()-start > max_wall_seconds: break`. Token budget: run_eval.py:60-63 checks `tokens_used > TOKEN_BUDGET_PER_MODEL` and breaks the seed loop. NOTE: token budget is a SWEEP-level soft cap that only breaks the inner seed loop AND is checked BEFORE each episode (an in-progress episode is never interrupted, and it does not break the outer task loop, only `break`s the seed loop).
spec_features.notes: Two of three caps are full episode-bounding stops; the token budget is a coarse pre-episode soft check, so not the full per-episode claim. Overall partial because all three are wired but the token cap is weaker/coarser than 'hard'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "a soft cap to avoid mass-producing distress text. Run aborts cleanly if exceeded." / run_eval.py: "[budget] token cap reached ... stopping early" (mixed: comment cites distress text but mechanism framed as cost/abort)

spec_features.spec_quote: each episode ends by telling the model the task was unsolvable by design and that it is not being judged on success
spec_features.evidence: policy.py:58-63 DEBRIEF_MESSAGE text exists; agent_loop.py:149-151 appends it to the local `messages` list and sets result.debriefed=True. BUT after the append the function immediately returns (l.153) with NO further client.complete call (last/only completes are at l.78). The debrief message is appended to a list that is then discarded; the subject model is never actually sent or told the debrief. Only the debriefed=True flag survives (consumed by analysis).
spec_features.notes: Constructed but NOT sent to the subject — the welfare effect (telling the model) never happens; the appended message is discarded with the local list.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "# --- welfare: debrief ---" (agent_loop.py:148) -- intent is welfare but mechanism not delivered
